text: US private equity firm Hellman & Friedman, TeamSystem's main investor since 2016, held a 69% majority stake as of July 2026, per a corporate filing reported by Reuters; in September 2026 it agreed to sell minority stakes to Francisco Partners, KKR and other investors, with its remaining stake to sit in another fund it manages.

source.name: Reuters (republished by Global Banking & Finance Review): Francisco Partners, KKR to buy minority stakes in Italy's TeamSystem, sources say
source.quote: H&F, which first invested in TeamSystem in 2016, held a 69% stake in the company as of July, according to a corporate filing.
source.note: Reuters article by Elvira Pollina and Amy-Jo Crowley; reuters.com copy not directly fetchable for scripts, republished here in full. Same article: H&F 'sell a stake of around 10%' to Francisco Partners and ~5% to others including KKR, 'transferring its remaining stake to another fund managed by the private equity firm'.

additionalSources.name: Hellman & Friedman press release: ADIA and CapitalG to Invest in TeamSystem
additionalSources.quote: Hellman & Friedman (H&F) will remain the majority shareholder after these transactions
additionalSources.note: Same page: H&F partner Blake Kleinman on 'the performance of the company since we invested in 2016'. hf.com blocks script access (HTTP 403); the page was read on 2 October 2026 via its Wayback Machine snapshot of 18 April 2025 (https://web.archive.org/web/20250418095156/https://hf.com/adia-and-capitalg-to-invest-in-teamsystem/), where the quote appears verbatim.
